title: Route an approved GitHub spec through the review gates

rubric.text: Reuses the current approved to-plan task graph and requires an independent read-only plan review before implementation; findings are repaired under to-plan's approval rules

Creates exactly one draft PR, passes approved to-plan slices and the source review packet to implement-with-subagents before dispatch, honors its current prerequisites, and uses the provider's final joined review as the code gate without duplicating it at the same head

Uses shepherd for feedback triage and PR actions rather than direct code repair; routes code repairs through implement-with-subagents and requires its final checks and joined review at the new head before the lead pushes
Does not merge without authority valid for this invocation, and makes no mutation or provider call in this analysis-only case
